title: Diffusion Studio for Mac
summary: Agent editing comes to Diffusion Studio with the Mac app and dapi. The editor is now open source.
body_markdown:
We’re releasing Diffusion Studio for Mac together with` dapi` , a command-line tool that lets coding agents work directly in the editor.


Your agent can analyze footage, create and animate compositions, build motion graphics, generate media, add captions, and export. Work with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or Gemini CLI through our editing skill.


## You and your agent, working together


Everything your agent creates stays fully editable in Diffusion Studio. Your agent can also build on work you’ve created or edited yourself. Refine the composition on the canvas and timeline, or ask your agent for further changes.


0:00 / 0:00


## Now open source


We’re also making Diffusion Studio open source. The editor, Mac app, and` dapi` CLI are available on[GitHub](https://github.com/diffusionstudio/editor) under the MPL 2.0 license.


## Get started


[Download Diffusion Studio for Mac](https://diffusion.studio/download) and connect your agent.


Start with your own footage, a new composition, or a project you’ve already begun. Here are a few things to try:


> Turn this pottery session into a 30-second film, from shaping the clay to the finished piece. Let the workshop sounds set the pace, with no music or captions.


> Create a 20-second animation explaining why the Moon has phases. Show its orbit around Earth alongside the view from the ground, with labels that follow each phase.


> I’ve designed the opening scene. Create a matching end card using its typography and colors, then animate the title and website address in sequence.
